answer:
Mission Local reported that three friends arrived at the GameStop on Mission Street at 6 a.m. to buy “The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom.” Over the next three hours, about 10 other gamers lined up behind them. The friends were hoping to get the limited collector’s edition; they secured the first three places to buy it, and Carrillo was first to purchase the game at 10 a.m.

Story: “People We Meet: In line for Zelda at GameStop,” published May 13, 2023.

Correction: An earlier version said this was the last GameStop in San Francisco. Mission Local corrected that there is another GameStop in Stonestown Galleria.
